snippet.title: Giant Snake Girl wants The Burger- Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Giant Snake Girl is hungry for The Burger! As a silly Tsuchinoko who's also her best friend, it's Loaf's duty to find these burgers for her big friend, in this rather snake-like puzzle game that'll truly test if you're as smart as a snake.

Available for free here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4212730/Giant_Snake_Girl_wants_The_Burger/
https://woah-maaan.itch.io/giant-snake-girl-wants-the-burger
